routes.name: North Coast 500
routes.blurb: A loop from Inverness round the far north of Scotland. Single-track roads, beaches and the Bealach na Bà climb

routes.name: Atlantic Highway
routes.blurb: The A39 down the north coasts of Devon and Cornwall, from Barnstaple to Newquay. Cliffs, coves and Tintagel Castle

routes.name: Cambrian Way
routes.blurb: The A470, the Dragon’s Spine, from Cardiff Bay to Llandudno. The Brecon Beacons, the Elan Valley and Eryri

routes.name: Coastal Way
routes.blurb: The length of Cardigan Bay, from St Davids to Aberdaron. Beaches, harbour towns and castles

routes.name: Causeway Coastal Route
routes.blurb: The Antrim coast from Belfast to Derry. The Glens of Antrim, Carrick-a-Rede and the Giant’s Causeway

routes.name: Route des Grandes Alpes
routes.blurb: Lake Geneva to the Mediterranean over the high passes of the French Alps. The Iseran, the Galibier, the Izoard and the Col de Turini

routes.name: Route Napoléon
routes.blurb: Napoleon’s road from the Riviera to Grenoble. Grasse, the climb to Castellane and the Alps of Provence

routes.name: Great Dolomite Road
routes.blurb: Bolzano to Cortina d’Ampezzo through the heart of the Dolomites. Lago di Carezza and the Pordoi and Falzarego passes

routes.name: Three Classic Passes
routes.blurb: A day’s loop from Meiringen over the Grimsel, Furka and Susten passes, past the Rhône Glacier

routes.name: Romantic Road
routes.blurb: Würzburg to Füssen through medieval Bavaria. Rothenburg, Dinkelsbühl and Neuschwanstein Castle
